summary: Whether you show it or not, a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it. Owned, you draw people in and know what you want and you imagine, feel for others, and create.
body: Whether you show it or not, a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it. Owned, you draw people in and know what you want and you imagine, feel for others, and create. Real artistic gifts; guard against unrealistic expectations of people and outcomes.
gift: At your best: you draw people in and know what you want, and you imagine, feel for others, and create.
shadow: The trap: you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it — or you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline.
integration: Let love and values and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Real artistic gifts; guard against unrealistic expectations of people and outcomes.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you draw people in and you imagine, feel for others, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
